verification.verification_notes: Confirmed author, publisher, 19 September 1923 first publication, and the count of 46 titled plus 7 untitled quatrains (53 total) via reference records; composition of most poems in Sandesh between 1915 and 1923. Mechanisms confirmed through Mukherjee 2022 and The Tenth Rasa 2007. No text reproduced.
